title.zh: Quants are paying $4,000 a month to front-run Solana trades
title.en: Quants are paying $4,000 a month to front-run Solana trades

current_state.zh: An investigation alleges that Solana validators, including Everstake, sell $4,000/month private feeds of pending transactions to quants who use them to front-run and sandwich-attack ordinary DeFi traders.
